propositions: Container tickets inherit their direct children's declared file_impact for plan-review dependency scope computation, avoiding whole-HEAD fallback invalidation when child scope is known

If any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, inheritance is poisoned and the container's signed dependency set reverts to pre-change behavior (own impact + citations), preserving fail-closed semantics
Closed children neither contribute files to the inherited union nor poison it, since their work is already delivered and later file churn belongs to other tickets
Child edits to file_impact or child add/remove operations invalidate the container's attestation via material fingerprint pin drift, triggering re-review that recomputes inherited scope
The P9 determinism floor extends to surfaces an advisory (non-blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the children with empty file_impact
Plan-review claim gate succeeds for unrelated commits when inheritance is effective, but fails (naming drift) for commits touching child-declared files
